title: The internal audit
description: The internal audit of the plan (ISO 9001, 9.2): the report with the evidence, approved by the internal auditor; management decides the actions.

steps.title: Decide the actions
steps.task: Read the internal audit report and decide: for every finding, the correction or the corrective action (ISO 9001, 10.2), who does it and by when. The decision, with who and when, stays in the round log.

produces.note: the actions decided, finding by finding
